slides.title: HNSW vs Flat Indexing
slides.prompt: What benefit does Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) indexing provide over Flat L2 indexing in vector databases?
options: Sub-linear, logarithmic query latency during Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) search on massive datasets
100% exact brute-force search accuracy with zero recall loss
Reduced disk storage space requirement by converting vectors to plain strings
Eliminating the need for text embedding models
slides.correctAnswer: Sub-linear, logarithmic query latency during Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) search on massive datasets

slides.title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) in Hybrid Search
slides.prompt: Why is Hybrid Search combining Sparse Keyword Search (BM25) and Dense Vector Search effective in RAG pipelines?
options: It captures both exact keyword terminology matches and deep semantic context meaning simultaneously
It lowers the total memory consumption of LLM models
It eliminates the need for document chunking steps
It encrypts document database records in vector stores
slides.correctAnswer: It captures both exact keyword terminology matches and deep semantic context meaning simultaneously
